name: Haus Sonnenhof
beschreibung: The Haus Sonnenhof is a holiday apartment in Tirol. The accommodation is located in a quiet location with a view of the Alpen. The apartment has a fully equipped kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom. A balcony is also available. In the surrounding area there are hiking trails and ski areas. Guests can explore the nature and the mountain world. The accommodation is suitable for a stay by couples or small families.
